result.rationale: Dimension Energy LLC is one qualifying US distributed-energy platform; Dimension Renewable Energy is its former brand. Partners Group's control deal closed 2021-06-24 and remains active; no later sponsor change was found.

identityResolution.boundary: Count one developer-owner-operator platform; exclude project LLCs, portfolios, tax-equity vehicles, project JVs and assets.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: The two brands are one company; no supplied production/seed match.

ownershipResolution.strategy: Partners Group Private Infrastructure Americas; exact fund allocation NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

currentOwners.fund: Client infrastructure accounts; exact allocation NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED
currentOwners.vehicle: PG Delta Holdco LLC; Partners Group Access 177 PF LP held ~70% at 2023-05-10
currentOwners.stake: Controlling; PG Delta owned 100% of Dimension Energy LLC in 2023; exact manager stake NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED

formerOwners.vehicle: Direct Class A units of Dimension Energy LLC
formerOwners.stake: 23.58% at 2020-12-31; ~23% at exit; entire interest sold

ownershipResolution.otherDirectEquity: Founders Dobrzynski/Youneszadeh and Series A investors Rodgers/Sahade: stakes/outcomes UNRESOLVED; 50.71% of the 2020 cap table was unitemized.
ownershipResolution.currentMinority: PG Delta's ~30% remainder was unidentified in 2023; no other holder exceeded 10%.

operatingResolution.model: Develops, finances, owns and operates distributed solar, storage/grid support and localized power.
operatingResolution.communitySolar: Local-project subscribers receive utility-bill credits/savings without rooftop installation.
operatingResolution.customers: Households, businesses, utilities and large energy users, including data centers, telecom and electrified industry.
operatingResolution.footprint: 1.1+ GW developed across IL, NY, PA, NJ, VA, CA, ME, DE and MN.
operatingResolution.scale: 600+ MW operating/under construction, $2B+ invested and 35,000+ subscribers by August 2026.
operatingResolution.infraBasis: Long-lived owned generation/storage and IPP operations; not a pure developer or service provider.

acquisitionExitCheck.close: Partners Group announced 2021-06-28; FTC Solar proves consummation on 2021-06-24.
acquisitionExitCheck.terms: Controlling stake; percentage, price and any primary capital NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. FTC's sale proves a secondary component.
acquisitionExitCheck.sellers: FTC Solar sold its entire ~23%; other member sale/rollover is UNRESOLVED.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No later platform equity round, sponsor, partial sale, merger, exit or signed pending ownership deal found through 2026-08-19. Dimension said on 2026-08-17 that it is owned by Partners Group.
acquisitionExitCheck.excludedCapital: HASI's 2024 equity was in a project JV; later corporate/project debt and tax equity are not platform ownership.

milestones: 2018-06-18: launched as Dimension Renewable Energy after Series A/B.
2021-06-24: Partners Group control deal closed; FTC Solar exited.
2026-08-17: confirmed Partners Group ownership and 600+ MW operating/under construction.
beforeAfterChanges: Use Dimension Energy; retain former-name alias.
Do not split holdco, projects or financing vehicles.
excludedOrDuplicateCandidates: PG Delta Holdco LLC: owner vehicle.
Lenders, tax equity, HASI project JV, customers/subscribers: not platform owners.
